statement: g02's report-view module (crates/enforcer-ui/src/report/mod.rs) does NOT re-derive the base UiFindingRow shape (ruleId/severity/title/detail/file/line/snippet) -- it calls crate::payload::render_report (arc-24-owned) to get the UiReportPayload, then adds an enrichment+grouping layer on top: ReportRow wraps each UiFindingRow with tier + docAnchor (looked up via enforcer_rules::registry::RuleRegistry::get(&RuleId) keyed on the row's own ruleId) plus crateName (derived from the file path). ReportViewPayload flattens violations+warnings+waived into one rows: Vec<ReportRow> list, keeps waived rows VISIBLE (indexed via waived_row_indices, never removed), and adds ReportGroups (by_severity/by_tier/by_file/by_crate, each Vec<RowGroup{key,row_indices}> built with BTreeMap for stable ordering).
why: The workpack (g02-scan-report-ui.md) requires each row to carry RuleId + why/doc-anchor + RelPath:line + grouping by severity/tier/file/crate, at the Rust boundary. arc-24's payload.rs already had the base row shape but no tier/doc-anchor/crate enrichment or grouping -- adding it as a wrapper layer (not editing payload.rs, which is arc-24-owned) keeps the file ownership disjoint.
howToApply: g03 (row-level actions) should attach its action payload keyed on ruleId+file+line against ReportRow -- ReportRow deliberately carries no action field so g03 can extend without this module changing shape underneath it.

statement: g02's silent-mode gate (RunMode::Silent -> ReportViewPayload::default() before touching the registry or the report at all) mirrors g08's explorer::RunMode pattern exactly, same f04 seam rationale (enforcer-core's formal run-context gate has not landed; every Track G view takes an explicit RunMode parameter rather than reading ambient state). Proved by report::tests::silent_mode_suppresses_all_output.
why: Consistency across g02/g08 (and presumably g03-g06) means a future f04 landing threads the real signal into the same RunMode-shaped parameter everywhere without changing any view's contract.
howToApply: Any new Track G view module should add its own local RunMode enum (Human/Silent) rather than importing one crate-wide, matching this established per-module convention, until f04 formally lands in enforcer-core.

evidence.ref: cargo test -p enforcer-ui report::tests::silent_mode_suppresses_all_output -- PASS; crates/enforcer-ui/src/explorer/mod.rs RunMode

statement: crates/enforcer-ui/src/ts_export.rs (arc-24/g05-owned pipeline) currently exports only Report and UiReportPayload bindings -- it was NOT extended to export g02's new ReportRow/ReportViewPayload/RowGroup/ReportGroups types, since ts_export.rs/tests/ts_drift.rs/tests/cross_lang_roundtrip.rs are explicitly g05's owns: per WORKPACK_INDEX.md (arc-24 preamble), not g02's. g02's types still derive ts_rs::TS correctly (satisfying the checklist's 'frontend types derived via ts_rs' requirement structurally) but are not yet in the committed frontend/src/bindings/ output.
why: File-disjointness discipline: g02 owns only crates/enforcer-ui/src/report/; editing ts_export.rs would step on g05's owned files. Flagging this as a known gap rather than silently leaving it undiscovered.
howToApply: A future lane (g05 or the integrator) should add ReportViewPayload::export_all_to(out_dir) alongside the existing Report/UiReportPayload calls in ts_export::export_all, then regenerate frontend/src/bindings/ and the ts_drift fixture.
